tests: Playwright: applyEditorSelection(null, 'accommodation', null) → slot_drop_visible=true, droppable=true, board_card_visible=true, section_header=FOUND

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A — logic bug in existing code
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: The accommodation Section was gated on `day.accommodation &&` — when mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay merges editorSelections={key:null} into publishedDay, day.accommodation becomes null, hiding the entire Section. No empty drop zone remained for the user to drag a candidate back.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: IIFE checks both day.accommodation (normal case) and the _accDeselected+_edAcc condition (deselected but candidates exist). When deselected, [{}] provides an empty acc object so the card renders as an empty drop zone with slot-drop overlay. The existing slot-drop onDrop handler is untouched and works as-is.

dev.qa_notes: Test by: (1) open trip in Kanban view, (2) drag accommodation board card to sidebar, (3) verify Section header '🏨 Accommodation' is still visible in board, (4) verify .slot-drop[data-slot-id='accommodation'] has data-droppable='true', (5) drag a candidate from sidebar back to the slot — card should appear.

self_verification.notes: Playwright run_code test: applyEditorSelection(null,'accommodation',null) → slot_drop_visible=true, droppable=true, board_card_visible=true, section_header=FOUND (in board, not sidebar). Both HTML files regenerated and deployed successfully.
